text:
Emma: quick q — our new hire (moving UK -> US) just told me their partner's due date moved up and they need to fly back for a few weeks overlap. Is there any way to get an expedited travel + childcare top-up while they get set up? don’t want to block the hire but also need to be compliant. :wave:

Raj: filing this under ‘exceptions’ might be possible. do you have dates and cost estimate? we usually require receipts + manager signoff. for international relocation cases we can do a one-time relocation advance.

Emma: thanks — partner due ~May 10, new hire starts May 20, but they'd want to fly home May 5–June 2. rough airfare + 4 weeks backup childcare estimate = $6k. manager is Jordan, copied.

Jordan: I can approve a short-term exception if People Ops ok with policy. priority is not to delay onboarding. is this paid as relocation or as a parental leave accommodation?

Leah: from benefits side: parental leave pay is separate and only applies after tenure thresholds. travel/childcare for an immediate family emergency can sometimes be processed as an "exceptional hardship reimbursement" via the People Ops fund, but we need: 1) short written justification, 2) manager approval, 3) receipts. max one-time up to $7k for extraordinary circumstances.

Raj: procedural notes — please open an HR case so we have audit trail. include: a) dates b) estimated costs c) manager signoff (Jordan), d) confirmation of new hire start date. I'll assign and flag for expedited review.

Emma: filing HR case now — HR-2026-112 (placeholder). pinging here when done.

People Ops Bot: HR case HR-2026-112 created by Emma. Current status: intake -> awaiting documentation. Link: https://redwoodinternal/hr/cases/HR-2026-112

Leah: while you open the case, please attach a short statement from the new hire confirming partner relationship and travel needs (one paragraph is fine). we try to be consistent across cases.

Jordan: confirming manager signoff here — approved in principle pending documentation.

Emma: uploaded docs and a 1-paragraph note to the case. asked the candidate to provide the receipts as soon as travel is booked.

Raj: got it. I'll triage today and aim for decision within 48 hours. if approved, finance will issue a relocation advance to the new hire's payroll profile (subject to clawback terms if they don't start).

Emma: perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

People Ops Bot: Reminder: exceptional hardship approvals require retention clawback clause when processed as advance. See policy excerpt: 
```
Expense Code: EH-ADV
Approval Flow: Manager -> People Ops -> Finance
Max Amount: $7,000
Repayment Terms: 100% if hire fails to start within 30 days of agreed date
```

Leah: yep. one more thing — if this becomes ongoing childcare beyond 12 weeks, we should look at FMLA/partner leave eligibility and longer-term accommodation.

Jordan: noted. Jordan will coordinate with the hiring manager team to update start date if anything shifts.

Emma: closing loop here once HR case resolved, will post final outcome in this thread. thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
